findings: Q16 LUT has zero mismatches against the stated round-to-nearest formula for valid cells; it remains an approximation to Shannon entropy.
N=8 is allowed by range guard but shift of a u8 by 8 panics with overflow checks; observed unchecked optimized build returns incorrect zero class mask.
No n validity error propagates from compute_quotient_entropy: n=0,9 give (0,0), and caller-provided true produces VerifiedGenuine.
Row grouping assumes an actual equivalence relation; arbitrary symmetric NLI relation need not be transitive.
Entropy of up to8 nonempty classes can reach3bits=196608Q16, exceeding65535.
Rust threshold is approximately0.85bits; Lean example22282 approximately0.34bits, not0.85.
